title: Targeted Promotions on an E-Book Platform: Crowding Out, Heterogeneity, and Opportunity Costs
eligible_reason: Randomized experiment with a single treatment date; the only DiD is a 2x2 robustness check in the Web Appendix.
design_notes: Randomized field experiments on an Asian e-book app (Study 1, N = 20,436 targeted-fit customers; Study 2, N = 77,731; supplemental event-ticket study). Main comparisons are cross-sectional between randomized arms. A pre/post DiD specification is mentioned only as a robustness check in Web Appendix B. All treated users are treated on the same promotion date. The paper's second part is a targeting / machine-learning exercise.
screener_notes: Not eligible: randomized experiment, single treatment date. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. Data come from a cooperating e-book platform and are not public.
